items.text: In consecutive adults booked for major abdominal surgery, what are the sensitivity and specificity of a 30-second sit-to-stand count of 10 or fewer, done at pre-assessment, for an anaerobic threshold below 11 mL/kg/min or inability to complete exercise testing within two weeks?
items.population: Consecutive adults booked for colorectal, upper gastrointestinal, liver or pancreatic resection
items.intervention: 30-second sit-to-stand test, cut-off 10 or fewer (index test)
items.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity for anaerobic threshold below 11 mL/kg/min or inability to complete testing
items.time: Reference test within two weeks of the index test
items.setting: Pre-assessment clinics of one surgical centre

finer: Feasible with physiotherapy support and five exercise test slots a week; interesting to the prehabilitation team; novel as a validation; ethical with consent and no change to care until results are known; relevant to allocating 40 places a quarter.
summary: One accuracy question with a pre-specified cut-off and a rule for untestable patients.
